title: A missing glyph hides every notice on the viewer's status line
body:
In `crates/acre-gui/src/app.rs`, `App::status` shows the source error first, then the first missing-glyph warning, then `notice`. A drawing whose text has a character no font covers keeps the missing-glyph warning on the status line for as long as the drawing is open. Every notice is hidden behind it. That includes the reason a drag was refused, the "drawn by line N" from a click, and a file that cannot be opened or written.

## Proposal

Show a notice newer than the last build ahead of the missing-glyph warning, or show both side by side.
close_reason: Fixed in d32efef. App::status shows notice before the missing-glyph warning, and App::show clears notice on a successful build.
